Join Albert Heijn Online as a delivery driver in Nijmegen! Earn €18.83 gross per hour from age 21 and work 12–32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? Hourly salary: €18.83 gross per hour (all-in) for employees aged 21 and older, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. Working hours: 12 to 32 hours per week. Paid leave: 25 vacation days per year based on full-time employment, calculated proportionally for part-time employees. Travel allowance: Commuting reimbursement according to the applicable policy. Pension scheme: Pension contributions through the applicable scheme. Employee benefits: Discounts and benefits through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Salary payments: Weekly or every four weeks. Training: Guidance from an experienced delivery driver. Career opportunities: Potential for long-term employment and further development. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Oosterhout (Nijmegen) Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online delivery location in Oosterhout, close to Nijmegen. Before leaving the depot, you prepare your delivery van. You check the grocery orders, make sure the correct crates are ready and load everything securely. Once your van is prepared, you start your delivery route. Using the delivery app, you drive to different addresses in the Nijmegen area and surrounding locations. At each stop, you carefully unload the correct groceries and deliver them to the customer. You are an important part of the customer's shopping experience. A friendly attitude, reliable service and careful handling of groceries are essential. During your route, you also collect empty crates and returnable packaging. When necessary, you process payments and record delivery information or any issues in the delivery app. After your final delivery, you return to the depot in Oosterhout. You unload returned materials, clean and tidy your van and complete your shift. This role offers independence, responsibility and plenty of variety throughout the working day. AlbertHeijn Online operates from Monday to Sunday. There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:00. Afternoon/evening shift: 15:00 – 23:00. Your availability will be discussed with the planning team. Please note that being available for at least two Saturdays every month is a strict requirement for this position. 1. Can I apply if I speak English but not Dutch? Yes. You can apply if you speak English or Dutch well enough to communicate with customers and colleagues and understand work instructions. You do not need to be fluent in both languages. 2. Do I need previous experience as a delivery driver? No, previous delivery experience is not necessary. You will receive training and guidance from an experienced colleague. During your introduction, you will learn how to load the van, use the delivery app, follow routes and deliver groceries safely and professionally. 3. Can I choose my working days, and do I have to work on Saturdays? You can discuss your preferred working days and shifts with the planning team. Morning and afternoon/evening shifts are available, depending on operational needs. However, availability for at least two Saturdays per month is mandatory. This is a strict requirement for everyone applying for this position. 4. How much will I earn, and how often will I be paid? Employees aged 21 and older receive a gross all-inclusive hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. Your net salary depends on your individual tax situation. Through Consolid, you can choose to receive your salary weekly or every four weeks. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Oosterhout (Nijmegen) A valid category B driving licence. The ability to drive safely and responsibly. Physical fitness to lift and carry grocery crates. Good communication skills in English or Dutch. A friendly and customer-focused attitude. Your own transportation to the delivery location in Oosterhout. Availability to work 12 to 32 hours per week. Mandatory requiremen
